title: 76 Hub Pre Gui Reborn
features:
🎮 76 REBORN GUI v2.0 - Premium Mobile Executor
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⭐ FEATURES:

📜 SCRIPT MANAGER
• Save unlimited scripts with custom names
• Execute scripts with one click
• Delete unwanted scripts easily
• Search scripts by name (real-time filtering)
• Favorites system - Mark your favorite scripts with ⭐
• Filter view: Show all scripts or favorites only
• Auto-save: All scripts saved automatically to file
• Persistent storage: Scripts remain after reopening

🎮 PLAYER CONTROLS
• Walk Speed Slider (16-200)
• Jump Power Slider (50-300)
• FOV/Field of View Slider (70-120)
• Real-time adjustments with visual sliders
• Auto-apply on character respawn

👁️ ESP SYSTEM (Working!)
• Player ESP - See all players through walls
• Box ESP - Draw boxes around players
• Name ESP - Display player names
• Health ESP - Show player health with color coding
  - Green: High health (>50%)
  - Yellow: Medium health (25-50%)
  - Red: Low health (<25%)
• Toggle each ESP feature independently
• Billboard GUI system for smooth performance

⚡ PERFORMANCE
• FPS Boost toggle - Optimize game performance
  - Reduces graphics quality
  - Disables post effects
  - Removes shadows and water reflections
• Background Blur toggle - Blur game background when GUI is open

🎨 THEMES (5 Options)
• Sunset - Warm red/orange/yellow gradient
• Techno - Purple/blue/cyan gradient  
• Dark Neon - Black with neon green accents
• Normal - Clean black/white/gray
• Rainbow - Animated rainbow colors (color cycling!)
• Each theme has unique gradient backgrounds
• Animated gradient rotations

🌐 LANGUAGES
• Turkish (TR) 🇹🇷
• English (EN) 🇬🇧
• Easy to switch between languages
• All UI elements translated

✨ UI FEATURES
• Modern gradient design with transparency
• Smooth animations and transitions
• Draggable main window - Move anywhere on screen
• Draggable mini logo when minimized
• Resizable GUI - Drag bottom-left corner to resize
  - Min size: 500x250
  - Max size: 900x500
• Minimize to small floating logo
• 2-layer background system with animated gradients
• Premium loading screen with animated bar

💾 SETTINGS
• Save settings button - Manual save
• Reset settings to default
• Delete all scripts option
• Auto-save on changes
• Persistent settings across sessions

📱 MOBILE OPTIMIZED
• Touch-friendly interface
• Large buttons for easy tapping
• Optimized for Delta Executor
• Works on all mobile devices
• Smooth performance on low-end phones

🔒 SECURITY
• No malicious code
• Open source on GitHub
• Safe to use
• No data collection

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📥 HOW TO USE:

1. Copy the script code
2. Open Delta Executor (or any mobile executor)
3. Paste and execute the script
4. GUI will appear with loading animation
5. Use the menu on the left to navigate:
   - 📜 Scripts - Manage your scripts
   - 🎮 Player - Adjust player settings
   - 👁️ ESP - Toggle ESP features
   - ⚙️ Settings - Change theme, language, FPS boost
   - ℹ️ About - Version info

6. Add scripts by clicking "+ Add Script"
7. Click ⭐ to favorite scripts
8. Use search bar to find scripts quickly
9. Drag the GUI to move it
10. Drag the resize handle (bottom-left) to resize

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🐛 BUG FIXES in v2.0:
• ✅ ESP now works correctly (real ESP system)
• ✅ Script deletion now saves properly
• ✅ Scripts persist after closing GUI
• ✅ Favorites system working
• ✅ Search function optimized
• ✅ No more duplicate scripts
